properties.decision: Anthony's choice, 2026-10-27: "Keep a short pointer". Every seed the edge-prose check was silent on (no prior snapshot) keeps its entry in propagate_change's `stale_edge_evidence`, and the entry's `coverage_note` becomes a short pointer ("No prior snapshot: see stale_edge_evidence_silent_on.") to the one explanation under the new `stale_edge_evidence_silent_on` {count, seeds, coverage_note}. Nothing is removed. The whole reply stays within its budget: the per-seed entries give rows to the budget like a list's, each counted in budget.lists_shortened.
properties.name: propagate_change keeps each silent seed's stale-edge note, shortened to a pointer to the one summary
properties.rationale: The first fix grouped the silent seeds and dropped their per-seed entries, which removed something a client could read; his standing rule is that MCP changes are additive and a removal needs a deprecating release first. A pointer keeps every entry and its field while saying the paragraph once (541 copies were 55,599 characters on a 579-seed change of reflow2's own design). Options put to him: keep a short pointer (chosen), or remove the per-seed entries after a deprecating release. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
